snippet.title: Tiny Delivery - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812830/Tiny_Delivery/

You play as a small food delivery robot with a simple task — to bring an order to its destination. But the journey becomes much more than just a delivery. Roll through a charming neighborhood, weave through alleys and parks, and experience the everyday lives of the people around you. Children might invite you to bike races, an old man needs help getting an apple from a tree, and a stray cat may just hitch a ride.

Tiny Delivery is a short, heartfelt adventure filled with little stories — some joyful, some bittersweet. You’ll find hidden secrets, spontaneous moments, and gentle reminders of life’s quiet beauty.

Meet the Dev (Sinica)
